name: Genius ERP
description_en:
Genius ERP is manufacturing ERP connecting engineering/production, planning, purchasing, job costs and financial work. Its documented emphasis is the shop’s job and resource structure, not a generic office task board.

This profile concentrates on production planning and estimated-versus-actual job costing. Commercial scope depends on the manufacturing business, users, hosting and selected features. No job, schedule or costing report was run, and vendor implementation-success statistics were not independently validated.
description_zh:
Genius ERP 是连接工程生产、规划、采购、工单成本及财务的制造 ERP。资料重点在工厂的工单和资源结构，不是通用办公任务看板。

本文聚焦生产规划及预计与实际工单成本；商业范围取决于制造业务、用户、托管和所选功能。未运行工单、排程或成本报表，也未独立验证厂商实施成功率。

sections.title_en: Define the job before judging its margin
sections.title_zh: 判断毛利前先定义工单
sections.en:
The costing page describes estimates generated from BOM material and operation information, with budgets from estimates or work orders and comparisons by job, project, contract or item. It separately identifies labor, machines, materials and subcontract costs.

For a hypothetical custom machine, compare an initial estimate with actual purchased components, recorded shop time and an outsourced operation. Inspect which amounts are committed, consumed or still missing before trusting the job margin. This is an evaluation example, not a cost calculation performed by this research or a claim that all allocations configure themselves.
sections.zh:
成本页介绍从 BOM 物料及工序形成预计成本，以估算或工单建预算，并按工单、项目、合同或物品对照；另列人工、机器、材料和外协成本。

以假设的定制设备为例，将初始估计与实际组件采购、现场工时及外包工序对照。信任毛利前检查金额是已承诺、已消耗还是尚未记录。这是评估例子，未执行实际成本计算，也不表示所有分摊会自行配置。

sections.title_en: A schedule depends on real calendars and materials
sections.title_zh: 排程依赖真实日历与物料
sections.en:
The production page describes finite/infinite resource planning, predecessors/successors, job dates, material availability and milestone constraints. Work-center, machine, personnel and subcontractor calendars contribute to the plan, while timesheets and work-order progress update production visibility.

Evaluate two jobs sharing one constrained machine, then introduce a late component and an operation overrun. Inspect what reschedules and who approves the new priority. These are suggested checks. A Gantt chart does not establish a feasible production promise, and no throughput or bottleneck reduction was measured here.
sections.zh:
生产页介绍有限及无限资源规划、前后工序、工单日期、物料可用性及里程碑约束；工作中心、机器、人员和外协日历参与排程，工时及工单进度提供生产状态。

可评估两张工单共用一台受限机器，再加入组件延误和工序超时，检查如何重排及谁批准新优先级。这些是建议检查；甘特图不证明交期可行，本文未测吞吐或瓶颈改善。

sections.title_en: A tailored estimate must identify the manufacturing scope
sections.title_zh: 定制估价需明确制造范围
sections.en:
The official pricing page read on 22 October 2026 offers a personalized estimate rather than a public monetary rate. It identifies shop size, number of users, hosting model and required manufacturing features as pricing determinants, and links a calculator/guide for budgeting. No calculator result or sales quote was obtained.

Specify scheduling, engineering coordination, costing, integrations, migration, training and support in the proposal. Do not replace a quote with a third-party starting price or treat a calculator as a signed offer. Monthly price, currency and any free-production entitlement remain unknown.
sections.zh:
2026 年 10 月 22 日读取的官方定价页提供个性化估价，没有公开数字费率；页面列工厂规模、用户数、托管模式及所需制造功能为价格因素，并提供预算计算器和指南。本次未获取计算器结果或销售报价。

方案应明确排程、工程协调、成本、集成、迁移、培训和支持。不能用第三方起价替代报价，也不能把计算器当已签约方案。月费、币种及免费生产权限仍未知。

sections.title_en: Reconcile opening work and exceptions before go-live
sections.title_zh: 上线前对清在制工作及异常
sections.en:
Prepare BOM/routing versions, resource calendars, costing rates, inventory, open purchase orders, WIP and accounting balances. Use a representative job to reconcile operational quantities with financial cost and validate one engineering change, one late timesheet and a correction. These are editorial acceptance suggestions.

Genius ERP is worth investigating for a manufacturer needing this connection and able to own master-data and shop-floor discipline. A simple stock-and-invoice business may not need the same implementation. Exact deployment, connector operations, local statutory reporting, export/retention, licenses and restore behavior were not verified. Customer quotes and success percentages are vendor-selected evidence, not this profile’s test results.
sections.zh:
应准备 BOM 路线版本、资源日历、成本费率、库存、未结采购、在制及账务余额。用代表性工单把业务数量与财务成本对清，再验证工程变更、迟报工时及更正。这些属于编辑验收建议。

需要这些联系、又能维护基础资料和现场记录的制造商可以评估；简单库存开票企业可能无需相同实施。本文未核实确切部署、连接器操作、法定报表、导出保留、许可及恢复；客户引语和成功百分比属于厂商筛选证据，不是本文实测结果。
